articles.title: Accelerating the borderless Lakehouse: Announcing preview of cross-cloud caching
articles.summary: Google Cloud announces enhancements to its borderless Lakehouse, enabling fast and unified access to an organization's complete data estate.
articles.detail: The update allows for querying governed data directly where it lives, joining customer records across multiple clouds and on-premises environments.

articles.title: Reimagining service delivery in the agentic era with Google Public Sector
articles.summary: Google Cloud highlights its unified single-product architecture, flexibility across hyperconverged and disaggregated architectures.
articles.detail: The post discusses how state and local governments can achieve responsive, equitable, and accessible services using Google's technology.

articles.title: Changing the game: Using agentic AI to secure infrastructure code
articles.summary: Google AI and Infrastructure team transforms how security is approached with new AI-native methods.
articles.detail: The article discusses systematical and scalable approaches to securing infrastructure code using agentic AI.

articles.title: Choosing the right inspection architecture for AWS Network Firewall
articles.summary: AWS provides guidance on selecting the right inspection architecture for its network firewall.
articles.detail: The article discusses three deployment patterns available for AWS Network Firewall, including Traditional Inspection and Multiple VPC Endpoints.

articles.title: Microsoft recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Distributed Hybrid Infrastructure
articles.summary: Gartner highlights Microsoft's unified single-product architecture and flexibility across hyperconverged and disaggregated architectures.
articles.detail: The post discusses Microsoft's capabilities in distributed hybrid infrastructure, including its Azure platform.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Publishing Microsoft Foundry agents to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams
articles.summary: Microsoft announces general availability of publishing Microsoft Foundry agents to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams.
articles.detail: The update enables developers to make their agents operational and accessible to users across the platform.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: PG18 support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters
articles.summary: Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters now support PostgreSQL 18, bringing latest capabilities to distributed workloads.
articles.detail: The update enables building new applications or modernizing existing ones with performance, reliability, and data protection features.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: High-scale mesh in Azure Virtual Network Manager
articles.summary: Azure Virtual Network Manager now supports high-scale mesh connectivity configurations with up to 3,000 virtual networks.
articles.detail: The update enables customers to connect large numbers of virtual networks in a single mesh configuration.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Red Hat OpenShift with hosted control planes
articles.summary: Azure Red Hat OpenShift now offers a new deployment option with hosted control planes, running the OpenShift control plane as a fully managed service.
articles.detail: The update enables customers to build and deploy applications on a managed OpenShift environment.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: PostgreSQL skills and MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
articles.summary: Azure Database for PostgreSQL now offers a new plugin that combines expert-curated skills for PostgreSQL and Azure Data.
articles.detail: The update enables AI coding assistants to provide guidance and act on a connected database, turning them into context-aware experts.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Logical replication slot sync status metric for Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server
articles.summary: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now provides a new metric to monitor the synchronization status of logical replication slots.
articles.detail: The update enables customers to track the health and performance of their logical replication slots.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: New and improved troubleshooting guides for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
articles.summary: Azure Database for PostgreSQL now offers updated troubleshooting guidance to help customers diagnose issues.
articles.detail: The update provides expanded documentation to identify root causes of common problems.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-September 2026
articles.summary: Azure SQL now offers a range of updates and enhancements, including soft delete for the Azure SQL logical server.
articles.detail: The update enables customers to configure soft delete for their logical servers, among other features.

articles.title: Retirement Update: SAP container images removed October 14, 2026
articles.summary: SAP container images will be removed on October 14, 2026, and are currently unsupported and unmaintained.
articles.detail: Existing TLS-compliant agents may continue sending logs through the retired HTTP Data Collector API.

articles.title: Inside Petal: Building the World’s First Petabit-Class Transoceanic Subsea Cable
articles.summary: Meta announces its next-generation subsea cable, Petal, which will deliver petabit capacity at transoceanic distances.
articles.detail: The update discusses Meta's innovation in subsea cable technology and its expected benefits.
